title: Birbal: An efficient 7B instruct-model fine-tuned with curated datasets
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the methodology and performance of efficiently fine-tuning a large language model on a curated dataset for a diverse set of general tasks.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates models on general NLP tasks, including ethical reasoning based on philosophical frameworks like deontology and utilitarianism via the ETHICS benchmark, but not religious ethics or beliefs.
